column1: # Firmware effect ids — the authoritative table.
# switch in TcpMatrixServer::applyCommand) and documented in that repo's
# CLIENT_PROTOCOL.md. Effect id 0 is the 'stop effect' sentinel.
# PresetSpecTests asserts Presets matches this file exactly, so a firmware change
# shows up here as a failing test rather than as the panel quietly playing the
#          retired = still works and still resolves by id, but is a parameter
#                    variant of another effect; hidden from help and listings so
#                    nobody picks it by mistake. Ids are NEVER renumbered.
# color:   honours = the RGB payload changes the output
#          ignores = the renderer computes its own colours and discards the
#                    payload. The device still answers OK, so this is the only
#                    place a client can learn it.
